title: Accounts Administrator - Part time
company: PLANET RECRUITMENT SERVICES LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Senior Accounts Administrator

Location: Witney
Hours: 20 hours per week - flexible
Salary:£38,000-£40,000 pro rata

We're looking for an experienced Senior Accounts Administrator to join a busy team on a part-time basis. This is a varied, hands-on role with responsibility for coordinating the day-to-day accounts function, including sales and purchase ledger, payroll, credit control and general financial administration.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in a similar accounts role and be confident using Sage.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage the sales ledger, including invoice input, sales receipts and customer statements
- Process and reconcile purchase ledger transactions and supplier payments
- Process payment requests and issue remittance advices
- Match supplier statements and resolve any discrepancies
- Make domestic and international payments
- Chase outstanding invoices and support timely payment runs
- Process weekly payroll for salaried and hourly-paid employees using Sage

- Respond to employee payroll queries and resolve issues
- Carry out credit control, including chasing overdue payments and managing debtor issues
- Complete regular bank reconciliations and maintain accurate financial records
- Prepare management reports and month-end financial information
- Ensure HMRC tax and NI payments are made within deadlines
- Assist with VAT and other statutory financial reporting
- Support year-end accounting and liaise with external accountants
- Provide general support to colleagues with day-to-day accounts queries
- Provide cover across other areas of the accounts function and reception when required

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Experienced in a similar accounts administration role
- Confident using Sage Accounting
- Comfortable working across sales ledger, purchase ledger, payroll and credit control
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Confident dealing with suppliers, customers and colleagues
- Able to work independently and manage competing priorities
- Reliable, professional and proactive

Hours

20 hours per week, with flexibility around the working pattern. This can be discussed at interview.

If you're an experienced accounts professional looking for a flexible part-time opportunity with a varied role, we'd love to hear from you.
